svg.title: Spring Fairy Garden — step 5: Explore your fairy hideaway
svg.desc: Imagine who might visit and give your garden a name. Try a small rock shelter beside it if you like: use a broad, stable base and ask a grown-up to place a small flat roof stone. Photograph your garden, then take the structure down after play.
